regions.today: A mix of cloud and sunny spells for the rest of today with scattered showers. A few may turn heavy Light to moderate southerly breezes will veer southwest later. Winds may be fresh at times near the south coast.
regions.tonight: Tonight will bring cloud and clear spells. Scattered showers will become more isolated overnight and a few mist patches may develop. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 13 degrees with mostly light southwesterly breezes. Mildest along parts of the east coast.
regions.tomorrow: Sunny spells on Sunday, hazy at times, and some well scattered showers. The showers will die out in the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 16 to 20 degrees with light to moderate west to southwest winds. Again, winds may be fresh at times near the south coast.
regions.solar_uv: High in sunshine on Sunday and Monday, otherwise moderate on Sunday and low to moderate on Monday.
